ambiguity_notes: Onset ambiguity: the ICE 10/10 at 08:10 on 2035-08-19 and the 'overnight' drop (documented 2035-08-20, event time not recorded) could be read as the drop happening on the night of 19-20 Aug, i.e. Day 6 only. I did not apply that reading because A26 turns 'overnight' mechanically into the range D-1 to D, and ReSauce must not guess beyond the table; the record date is inside the range, so 7.7. If the onset were taken as Day 6 only, it would be 7.1 with a signed difference of -1 (and the Day 5 ICE 10/10 would be a formal Grade 0 assessment on the record date). Not 7.5: the reasons in section 7.5 (attribution, conflicting assessments at the same time, barrier, consciousness wording) do not apply. The attending's ICE 10/10 at 09:15 on Day 6 is a separate later assessment, not a conflicting reading. The second-hand source ('per night-shift handover') is still a signed clinician note.
